_instructions: DNFL Last Team Standing (LTS) & High Score Rules Configuration
1. 'default': Global baseline rules applied across all leagues & conferences.
2. 'conferenceOverrides': Conference-specific overrides keyed by 2-digit ID ('00', '01', etc.).
3. 'leagueOverrides': Optional league-level overrides keyed by MFL League ID (e.g., '22883').
- 'lts_isEnabled' (boolean): true = enable LTS survival eliminations; false = disable.
- 'highScore_isEnabled' (boolean): true = highlight weekly high scorer; false = disable.
- 'lts_startWeek' (number | 'auto'): regular season week eliminations begin (e.g., 2 or 'auto').
- 'lts_endWeek' (number | 'auto'): final week of LTS eliminations (e.g., 12, 14, or 'auto').
